## Anima Turbo + Character Ref (Ref Adapter or SnapRef) + LLLite 3D pose

## Models (folders under `ComfyUI/models/`)

### Anima (Turbo)
- **diffusion_models/anima/** `anima-turbo-v1.0-int8-convrot.safetensors` — local INT8 conversion of
  [anima-turbo-v1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/circlestone-labs/Anima/blob/main/split_files/diffusion_models/anima-turbo-v1.0.safetensors).
  You can load the official bf16 file directly instead (pick it in *Base model*).
- **text_encoders/** [qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/circlestone-labs/Anima/blob/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors)
- **vae/** [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/circlestone-labs/Anima/blob/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors)

### Character reference
- **loras/** [anima_ref_adapter_v2_r64.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/ElectronGirl/anima-ref-adapter/blob/main/anima_ref_adapter_v2_r64.safetensors)
- **loras/** [snapref_v1b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/0ppxnhximxr/snapref-v1b/blob/main/snapref_v1b.safetensors)
  (SnapRef; non-commercial license)

### Pose control (LLLite)
- **model_patches/** [anima_3dpose_6200.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/toyxyz/Anima_ControlNet-LLLite/blob/main/anima_3dpose_6200.safetensors)

## Custom nodes

- [ComfyUI-Anima-Ref-Adapter](https://github.com/ElectronGirl/ComfyUI-Anima-Ref-Adapter) — Ref Latent, Ref Guider
- [SnapRef](https://huggingface.co/0ppxnhximxr/snapref-v1b/tree/main/comfyui/snapref) — copy `comfyui/snapref/` into `custom_nodes/`
- [comfyui-anima-safe-pag](https://github.com/iljung1106/comfyui-anima-safe-pag) — Anima Safe PAG
- [comfyui-anima-style-nodes](https://github.com/fulletLab/comfyui-anima-style-nodes) — Anima Style Explorer
- [ComfyUI-Pixaroma](https://github.com/pixaroma/ComfyUI-Pixaroma) — groups, switches, sliders, seed, resolution, load image
- [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy) — Any Switch, Image Comparer, Power Lora Loader (custom Anima LoRAs, empty by default)
- [ComfyUI_VNCCS_Utils](https://github.com/AHEKOT/ComfyUI_VNCCS_Utils) — Pose Studio
- [ComfyUI-Anima-CharRef-LLLite](https://github.com/quinteroac/ComfyUI-Anima-CharRef-LLLite) — Ref Adapter + Controls loader (needs ComfyUI-Anima-Ref-Adapter)

Install custom nodes with ComfyUI-Manager (*Install Missing Custom Nodes*) or
`git clone <url>` inside `custom_nodes/`, then restart ComfyUI.

**Defaults**: 8 steps euler/simple, CFG 1, REF ADAPTER guidance 1, SNAPREF strength 0, SnapRef on (Safe PAG only with the Ref Adapter), Safe PAG 1.3 (block 18).
The LLLite control models were trained on Anima Base; with Turbo they are experimental.

Layout based on the Krea 2 Pose Studio workflow by [foxfuressence](https://www.youtube.com/@foxfuressence).

widgets_values_named.text:
## Experimental: Turbo + Character Ref + LLLite 3D pose

Anima Turbo INT8, bf16, 8 pasos, CFG 1 y reference guidance 1.
Ref Adapter strength 1; LLLite strength 1, activo de 0 a 1.
Prompt inicial: 1girl. Semilla fija tomada de la última ejecución.

Pose Studio → render RGB sombreado sobre NEGRO → tamaño de salida → LLLite.
El maniquí coloreado aporta volumen, solapamientos y dedos; no usar esqueleto DWPose.
La referencia de personaje permanece separada y su frame no recibe LLLite.
Mantén el navegador abierto y carga esta copia para aplicar los ajustes de Pose Studio.

Se reutiliza ModelPatchLoader y LLLite nativo con un adaptador para el frame de referencia.
Pesos: models/model_patches/anima_3dpose_6200.safetensors.
Turbo + Ref Adapter es una combinación experimental; el modelo de control se entrenó en Anima Base.
https://huggingface.co/toyxyz/Anima_ControlNet-LLLite

{"text": "Turn on "Import a Pose?" and pick the source in "Pose source":
- Character Ref: copies the pose from the character image itself.
- Pose Ref: copies the pose from another image.
Pose Studio detects it with SAM3D and applies it to the mannequin; tweak it in 3D and run again.
Turn it off after importing to keep your manual adjustments.
